rubric_data.description: Evaluates how well the response directly addresses and fulfills the requirements stated in the original prompt or question. This includes answering all parts of multi-part questions, following specific instructions, and staying within the scope of what was asked.

evaluation_scale.condition: Does not address the question or provides irrelevant information
Partially addresses the question but misses key aspects
Fully and adequately addresses all aspects of the question

rubric_data.description: Assesses the degree to which the response content aligns with the expected or reference response. This measures semantic similarity, key information coverage, and whether the response captures the essential points and themes present in the expected answer.

evaluation_scale.condition: Response is substantially different from expected content
Response has moderate similarity to expected content
Response closely matches the expected content

rubric_data.description: Measures the objective correctness of factual claims, data, statistics, dates, names, and verifiable information presented in the response. This criterion focuses on whether the information provided is factually true and can be verified through reliable sources.

evaluation_scale.condition: Response contains factual errors or misinformation
Response has mostly correct facts with minor inaccuracies
Response is completely factually accurate

rubric_data.description: Evaluates the quality of summarization skills, including the ability to condense information while maintaining clarity, coherence, and completeness. This assesses whether the response effectively distills key points into a concise, well-organized format that captures the essence of the source material.

evaluation_scale.condition: Response is not a summary or is unclear and confusing
Response provides a basic summary but lacks clarity or completeness
Response provides a clear, comprehensive, and well-structured summary
